The Office of the Commissioner of Lobbying maintains a public registry at lobbycanada.gc.ca . OCL annual reporting records that over 359,000 communications have been logged since modern reporting began. This file cross-references those rows with Elections Canada returns, PBO analyses, AG reports, and Hansard — correlation is labeled; causation is not assumed from a meeting log alone.
Registry rows are facts. “Bought policy” is a headline frame — not a finding unless a primary shows the decision path.
On the record: who met whom, when, on which subject matter, under which registration.
